523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

8931|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

13-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
13-complete.text: Your worth to The People's Militia has been validated by your brave acts thus far.
13-complete.title: The People's Militia

13-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
13-progress.text: We have not time to talk, $N.  The Defias Pillagers are denying the people of Westfall the peace and prosperity they deserve.  Make sure at least 15 Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters have been killed.  That will send a clear message that corruption is not welcome here.
13-progress.title: The People's Militia

14-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
14-accept.text: Some Defias have eluded us.  My most trusted scout reports that these Defias have been looting and pillaging the countryside, all the way into Southern Westfall.  We believe they are hiding out in the Dagger Hills, plotting their next move.   Slay the wretches in the name of The People's Militia.
14-accept.title: The People's Militia

14-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
14-complete.text: When I left the tainted lands of Lordaeron I returned to a grim state of affairs here in my homeland.  But there is hope for Westfall yet.  As proven by your valor in battle, it is obvious to me that you serve our cause with honor.  It is with great pride that I induct thee into The People's Militia.  May the Light shine upon you.
14-complete.title: The People's Militia

14-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
14-progress.text: $N, now is no time for idle chatter.  If you still wish to prove yourself to The People's Militia you need to slay the Defias I notified you about earlier.  Return to me when you have completed your duty.
14-progress.title: The People's Militia

143-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
143-complete.text: Good Messenger, you have served your master well.
143-complete.title: Messenger to Westfall

143-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
143-progress.text: Hail, $c.  What business do you have with The People's Militia?
143-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

144-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
144-accept.text:
Magistrate Solomon's note pains me to read.  But it is obvious he knows not the war which is waged in Westfall or else he would know better than to expect aid from the Militia.  If Stormwind had not deserted us as well, we would not have the need for the Militia.

Take this response to your master in Redridge, $c.  And let him know that my heart is heavy with the loss of good men.
144-accept.title: Messenger to Westfall

155-accept.name: The Defias Traitor
155-accept.text:
So Stoutmantle sends a scrawny $r like you to protect me?  Guess you'll have to do.  Better bring some friends too. 

You know the deal, right?  You watch my back and I'll take you to the Defias hideout.  But you better be close by my side.  The Defias gang wants my head now.  If they see me with you, they'll try to kill me.

Let me know when you and any friends you can round up are ready to go.
155-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

155-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
155-complete.text: Most excellent, $N!  VanCleef is as good as ours now that we know where he is hiding.
155-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

166-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-accept.text: There is but one task left for you to complete.  Edwin VanCleef must be assassinated.  While it saddens me to condemn any man to a death sentence, it is for the greater good of the people of Westfall that VanCleef is laid to rest once and for all.  Bring me the villain's head once the deed is done.
166-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

166-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-progress.text: How goes the hunt for Edwin VanCleef?
166-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

214-accept.name: Scout Riell
214-accept.text:
It's no secret that the trademark of the Defias Gang is their Red Bandanas.  But we've learned that the material from which these bandanas are made signifies the member's rank.

That being said, I want you to eliminate as many high ranking Defias members as you can.  The highest ranking members will undoubtedly be found in VanCleef's secret hideout.  When you're done bring me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof of their deaths and I will reward you.  Good luck, $N.
214-accept.title: Red Silk Bandanas

92745-progress.text: Do you have news from the mines?
92745-progress.title: The State of the Mines
